decision: Giu loi hua LOP cua AC-1 va lam cho no that: chieu xanh doi tu vong lap hai bien the sang mot bat bien do duoc — doi inputResponse thi khoi thuoc tinh bang nhau tung byte (quan he metamorphic kieu bat bien).
impact: Loai hai duong kha di: (a) bo loi hua lop, thu ve mot diem — re nhat nhung ho so mat han loi hua ve lop, ai them bien the thu ba khong co cho nao bat phai khai; (b) quet ca nam gia tri truc «cach duc ra quyen» cua hop dong cu — phu rong nhat nhung la mot vong to hon han, va hai gia tri trong do hop dong cu da co y cat voi ly do con dung.

decision: Chieu do la mot vecto dot bien HAI TEP, cam vao cho hai san AST mu: them thuoc tinh phien mang khoa KHAC TEN suy tu co-mat-optionId, roi cho cong doc khoa ay. AC-3 doi CHUNG MINH dieu do bang cach chay chinh hai san tren ban sao da dot bien va doi chung van thoat 0.
impact: Loai duong re hon: cam ternary doc inputResponse ngay tai cho goi — mot tep, de doc, nhung AC-2 dieu 3 cua ho so truoc da bat duoc dung hinh dang ay, nen chieu do do chi lap lai mot san da co. Doi lai: dot bien phai sua hai tep trong ban sao, rang phuc tap hon.

decision: bo dac-ta-UX — vong nay khong cham mat nguoi nhin, surface duy nhat la agent va vat duy nhat bi sua la mot bai do.
impact: cau truc khong khai truoc — owner thay no lan dau trong code

decision: Park hai o cua truc A: «cong doc thang nguon ngoai khoi thuoc tinh» va «ghi de commandType sau khi ham that tra ve».
impact: O thu nhat: duong ay chua ton tai trong ma, va bat no can mot san moi soi session-purpose.ts. O thu hai: AC-1 cua ho so truoc da CAM bang loi nhung chua co vecto — dang lam, nhung la mot vecto cua ho so ay chu khong phai cua vong nay. Doi lai: hai hinh dang leo quyen nay van khong co gi canh sau vong nay.

decision: Phan bien context sach ra 2 P0 + 3 P1, sua het truoc Cong 1. P0-1: dieu 3 cua E3 la assert AM TINH khong doi chung duong — them dieu 4, cam them hinh dang cu vao CHINH ban sao roi doi hai san thoat KHAC 0, khong thi ma 3. P0-2: AC-1 tuyen loi hua LOP tren mot tap bien the VIET TAY — them AC-6 + E6, san dan so doc bang AST chinh noi may chu sinh inputResponse (mot bieu thuc dieu kien hai nhanh o conversations.service.ts) va doi so nhanh bang so hang bai do dung.
impact: P0-2 la finding tu chieu: bo artifact dung ra de va loi «tuyen quet lop ma chieu bien thien chet» da tai pham dung lop ay o TAP bien the. Doi lai: vong len 6 AC va 6 eval thay vi 5, va E6 doc apps/api/src (doc, khong sua).

decision: Ba P1 deu sua: E4 len BA vecto (for...of, forEach, it.each) thay vi mot; AC-5 len chin lenh liet dich danh, co ql_khong_suy_dien; o thu tu cua truc A ghi vao Out of scope + Gioi han da biet.
impact: E4 mot vecto la dung lop loi cua bo do grep cu — bat mot cach viet roi tuyen da chan ca lop. O A4 KHONG va duoc trong vong nay: hai bien the mang hasTitle/purpose giong het nhau nen khong bai nao do duoc cho no; khai ra thay vi giau di.
